# Demo Co critic rules
These override the base rules wherever they conflict.

## Locked
B1. Canvas is 1200px wide; height fits the content.
B2. The title sits in the light blue title bar, centred, one line.
B3. Only DejaVu Sans.
B4. Only the brand palette; the primary blue is used for titles, markers and at most one highlight per item.

## Components
B5. Numbered markers are circles with a 3px accent border and the number in accent blue.
